name: Lady Evelin
description: A ward-maker of Gatstaf blamed for failed wards and killed by Mrs. Palter.

timeline.summary: At a council meeting in Gatstaf, Farmer Warin and his wife claim a possessed cow ate another and blame Lady Evelin's failed wards.
timeline.quote: One of our cattle is possessed!

timeline.summary: Elsa announces the bell-ringer Orwell is dead, and the trackers find the bodies of Orwell, Lady Evelin and Elder Somlon arranged in the woods.
timeline.quote: the same that had been done to the bell-ringer had been done to the ward-maker, Lady Evelin

pages_say.description: A ward-maker of Gatstaf blamed for failed wards and killed by Mrs. Palter.
